p: Two flagship models, a new chip, an agent home screen and labels for AI music.
Google's new flagship costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output, through 30 Nov. Source: Let's Data Science, 13 Oct.
Meta's first frontier model costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output on its API. Source: TechCrunch, 12 Oct.
Microsoft says it gets 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU-based systems. In production in 2027. Source: Data Center Knowledge, 13 Oct.
Workday's agent experience: you ask in plain language and Sana coordinates Workday agents to do the task. Available now. Source: Workday, 13 Oct.
Fully Gen AI, Partly Gen AI or No Gen AI, set by partners and YouTube's own detection. Source: Music Business Worldwide, 14 Oct.
